subject: Q1 usage reconciliation & renewal addendum — Solara Health (SOL-4531)
body:
From: Priyanka Rao <p.rao@solarahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: James Liu <james.liu@solarahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 usage reconciliation and overage for Solara Health (SOL-4531)

Hi Evelyn,

We finished our internal reconciliation for Q1 and found ~1.1M inference tokens over our committed capacity. I've attached our export (solara_trueup_statement_q1-2027.pdf) and highlighted the spike windows. Can you confirm Redwood's billed usage for the same period and share the invoice path for one-time settlement? We're targeting renewal next month and want to roll the catch-up into the renewal addendum if possible.

Priyanka
Senior Cloud Ops
Solara Health

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <p.rao@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage reconciliation and overage for Solara Health (SOL-4531)

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the export and the clear callouts. We ran the same lookback and our numbers align closely; the delta (~12k tokens) looks like sampling differences. I've attached a proposed top-up invoice (redwood_topup_invoice_20270506.pdf) that reflects the agreed unit rate from your current term.

Proposed options:
- One-time invoice for the full overage (fastest, standard accounting).
- Amortize over the first three months of the renewed term (eases cashflow).
- Apply as a credit against Q2 usage if you sign the renewal addendum by 15-May (we can offer limited credit for early renewal).

I also drafted a short addendum that increases committed capacity by 30% for the new 12‑month term and folds in the final top-up amount if you choose the roll-in option. Attaching draft addendum for legal (will share after you confirm commercial approach).

Evelyn Hart
Head of Account Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_topup_invoice_20270506.pdf

---

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 11:32 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Priyanka Rao <p.rao@solarahealth.com>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage reconciliation and overage for Solara Health (SOL-4531)

Thanks Priyanka — quick clarifying notes from finance and commercial:
- The top-up invoice uses the existing committed-rate SKU; if you prefer amortization, we'll split the invoice into three equal monthly charges and add a note on the renewal PO.
- For the roll-in-to-renewal option we need a signed addendum before 15-May to honor the promotional credit we discussed (10% of the overage as credit).
- If Solara chooses roll-in, legal will need a countersigned addendum PDF; I've put a draft in Drive.

Ben — would you like me to propose the amortization schedule or should we keep the single invoice option as primary?

Priya Natarajan
Senior Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <p.rao@solarahealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage reconciliation and overage for Solara Health (SOL-4531)

Priyanka — appreciate the quick turnaround. Commercially we'd prefer to offer the amortization to help Solara with cashflow during the renewal. If you sign the addendum that ups the committed tokens by 30% for 12 months we can:
- Amortize the invoice over 3 months (no extra fees).
- Provide a one-time 10% credit applied to the second amortized payment (as a renewal incentive).

If that's acceptable, Marcus (cc'd) can approve the accounting treatment and we'll issue the amortized invoices.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Priyanka Rao <p.rao@solarahealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage reconciliation and overage for Solara Health (SOL-4531)

Marking finance approval for amortization as described. Action items for clarity:
1) Solara to countersign the attached addendum (or send a signed note agreeing to roll-in) by 15-May to get the 10% credit applied.
2) Redwood will create three invoices dated 06-May/06-Jun/06-Jul for the amortized amounts; second invoice will reflect the 10% credit.
3) Legal will place the signed addendum in our contract folder and finance will route invoices to accounts.payable@solarahealth.com.

I'll issue the initial invoice once we receive either the signed addendum or a PO referencing SOL-4531 and the amortization schedule.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priyanka Rao <p.rao@solarahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage reconciliation and overage for Solara Health (SOL-4531)

Thanks all — we confirm the amortization path and will sign the addendum. Attached is the countersigned PDF (solara_signed-addendum.pdf). Please issue the first invoice and send the invoice to accounts.payable@solarahealth.com. We expect payment per standard Net30.

James Liu (Finance) will be the contact for AP — cc'd.

Priyanka Rao
Senior Cloud Ops
Solara Health
attachments: solara_signed-addendum.pdf

---

Next steps (internal): Ben/ Priya to create amortized invoices (dates per Marcus), Marcus to route to AP and Evelyn to update renewal checklist with the increased commitment.
